# Liquid Warp

**Distortion › Warp** · v1.0.0 · 40 frames at 30 fps (16–90)

The picture ripples and melts like a reflection in water, and the new scene ripples back into focus.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/liquid-warp@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Dreams and flashbacks
- Psychedelic and music edits
- Water and heat themes

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import liquidWarp from './transitions/06-distortion/warp/liquid-warp';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(liquidWarp, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 40 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | number | `120` | 0–400 | Peak displacement in pixels. |
| `scale` | number | `0.006` | 0.001–0.03 | Ripple size (smaller = bigger ripples). |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
